title: Eagle Mfg 1633 1-Drum Modular Low-Profile Spill Containment Platform (15-Gallon Sump, 2,000 lb Capacity)
description: EAGLE MFG 1633 is a modular spill deck for secondary spill containment of one 55-gallon drum. This uncovered, low-profile unit is made of polyethylene and is intended for secondary containment of leaks, drips, and spills beneath stored containers. It has a 15 gal spill capacity and a 2,000 lb load capacity for use in drum storage and handling areas where secondary containment is specified. Key Features: Single-drum capacity: Holds 1 standard 55-gallon drum. Spill capacity: Contains up to 15 gal of liquid. Load rating: 2,000 lb. Low-profile design: 6 1/2 in high for lower deck height during loading and unloading. Material: Polyethylene deck, grate, and pallet construction. Dimensions: 26 1/4 in L x 26 1/4 in W x 6 1/2 in H. Modular design: Includes U-channel connection strip and is compatible with ramp connection model numbers 1689 and 1689B. Fork handling: Compatible with standard forks; no forklift pockets. Configuration: Uncovered design with no doors and no drain. Compliance references: EPA 40 CFR 264.175 and SPCC. Color: Black grate with yellow pallet.
